name: precedence-handbook
source: hand-written for this repository — a stand-in shaped exactly like a real import, so the import path is exercised end to end without hosting anyone else's benchmark data
contamination: None known: these instances were written for this repository and have never been published, so no model has seen them. A real imported suite would almost certainly say the opposite, and that is the sentence the asterisk exists to carry — the point of this field is that it is read, not that it says no.
